games.name: Jeopardy
games.blurb: The quiz show / game of memes. Five categories of KDPhi and Lambda lore.
rules: Teams take turns picking a category and a dollar value.
The board shows the answer - respond in the form of a question.
Correct response: the team earns the value. Wrong: the team loses the value and the board opens to a steal.

games.name: Newlywed Game
games.blurb: Pairs answer questions about each other. Match = points.
rules: Split into pairs. One partner writes their answer down while the other is out of earshot.
Bring the partner back, ask the same question out loud.
A match is worth points for their team. Add your own bonus for a truly unhinged answer.

games.name: Police Sketch
games.blurb: Hosts describe a character feature by feature. Each team member draws one piece.
rules: Hosts pick a character and describe features one at a time - never the name.
Each group member draws one piece of the character per description, then rotates the paper.
Hosts each describe a single feature per rotation.
First team to correctly guess the character wins the round.

games.name: Spelling Bee
games.blurb: Alternating elimination spelling. Optionally a drinking game.
rules: Players spell one word at a time in alternating order across teams.
Miss a word and you are out.
The final person standing has to get their word right - otherwise the last eliminated member from each team hops back in.
The last person standing wins the game for their team.
No helping teammates.

games.name: Pool Noodle Cup Game
games.blurb: Knock cups off the table with a pool noodle. Cups knocked = points.
rules: One person per group goes at a time - four players in play at once.
No ganging up on one person.
Teams of five have to send one person twice.
However many cups you knock out is how many points you earn.

games.name: Beer Run
games.blurb: Collect the beers. Optionally a drinking game.
rules: Teams form a large circle, equidistant from a stack of beers in the center.
One player from each team per round.
Players have to collect 3-4 beers back to their side.
Most beers hauled home wins the round.

games.name: Relay Race
games.blurb: Outside, multi-leg relay. Each team leader facilitates a different team.
legs: Pool noodle jump rope race (three-person leg)
Mini beer pong (1 cup - you make it, you drink it)
Spin and carry an egg / golf ball with chopsticks
rules: All outside. Each team leader runs a leg for a team that is not their own.
Legs run back to back - finish yours before the next person starts.
Points awarded by finishing position for each leg.

games.name: Superlatives & Trophy
games.blurb: Group vote at the end of the weekend. Winning team takes the trophy.
rules: Group vote on each superlative at the final tally.
Best Dressed is judged off the Murder Mystery outfits.
Winning team gets the trophy. Losing team gets shots / a shotgun.

mystery.title: Murder at West Egg Manor
mystery.subtitle: A Great Gatsby-inspired murder mystery for 26 players
mystery.hook: At midnight the lights go out. When they come back, millionaire James Blackwell is dead in his private study - and five guests share the blame.
mystery.premise: A lavish soiree hosted by the mysterious millionaire James Blackwell. His extravagant parties attract politicians, socialites, bootleggers, jazz musicians and movie stars. At midnight the lights go out. When they return, Blackwell is dead in his private study. Everyone had a motive. The twist: five guests secretly conspired together.
mystery.hostNote: This setup is designed to encourage teamwork, bluffing and deduction while giving every player a meaningful role in a glamorous Roaring Twenties setting.

rounds.name: Round 1 - Cocktail Hour
rounds.description: Guests mingle, introduce themselves and exchange rumors.

rounds.name: Round 2 - The Murder
rounds.description: The body is discovered and the investigation begins.

rounds.name: Round 3 - Search the Mansion
rounds.description: Clues are released and players compare evidence.

rounds.name: Round 4 - Interrogations
rounds.description: Guests may privately question one another.

rounds.name: Round 5 - Final Revelations
rounds.description: Additional evidence is revealed before accusations.

rounds.name: Finale
rounds.description: Everyone votes for the five conspirators and names the mastermind.

characters.brief: Organized illegal liquor distribution. Blackwell planned to expose him. He provided access to the mansion through hidden tunnels.
Accepted bribes from the Syndicate. Blackwell possessed incriminating documents. The politician ordered servants away from the study.
A former lover of Blackwell. The singer stole a key to the study and distracted the guests with a special performance.
Loyal to the Syndicate. The chauffeur disabled the mansion telephone and controlled arrivals and departures.
The secret leader of the Syndicate. The socialite planned the conspiracy and destroyed the final piece of evidence.
